column6: Drift is an absorbing Markov chain taught via sampling intuition; stationary-process theory is not drawn on.
Magnetic-sector deflection uses the Lorentz force; edge is fine, A looks over-staged at expert.
NMR rests directly on nuclear spin magnetic moments.
Arrhenius needs activation energy and rate laws, not equilibrium thermodynamics; only an analogy links them.
Subset construction is standard one-way automata; 2DFAs are a later extension that builds on it.
Weathering is a component process of the rock cycle; dominant direction is weathering -> rock cycle.
Rock identification draws on mineral testing, not the reverse.
The concrete resource distinction needs only formation timescales, not the rock cycle as a system.
Diagenesis depends on burial temperature set by the geothermal gradient.
Absolute ages of fossils come from radiometric dating of bracketing rocks; A likely over-staged.
Stat-mech phase boundaries are distant; the binary-mixture phase-diagram edge already covers melt crystallization.
Eutectic and solid-solution diagrams help explain igneous crystallization sequences.
Partial-melting composition is read off binary phase diagrams.
Magma rheology applies the general viscosity concept.
Plate boundaries presuppose plates; the inversion is a staging issue (plate-tectonics likely over-staged).
Contact aureoles form around intrusions, so magma generation helps.
Surface friction and eddy viscosity draw on the viscosity concept.
Extratropical cyclogenesis is explained by baroclinic instability.
Moisture transport draws on saturation and humidity; A looks over-staged at expert.
Severe weather forecasting uses instability indices.
MCSs and supercells are forms of organized convection.
Latent heat release fuels severe convective storms.
Lifted index is a standard severe-weather diagnostic; overlaps with the indices edge.
Stratospheric warming comes from UV absorption in ozone photochemistry (Chapman cycle).
Thunderstorm likelihood is assessed with stability indices like LI.
Near-duplicate topics on the same concept staged three levels apart; a human should merge or restage.
Fundamentals cannot depend on an advanced application of ocean circulation.
expenditure-function-microeconomics is already the hard prereq; full duality theory only helps.
AD draws on consumption as a component but can be learned without the full consumption-function topic.
Persistence is driven by how expectations form; A may be over-staged.
Okun's law relates the output gap to unemployment, which requires potential output.
Present value draws on intertemporal discounting.
Agricultural surplus helps explain civilization features but the features can be learned without the Neolithic topic.
Rhetoric analysis is the narrower, more basic method; linguistic analysis subsumes rhetorical conventions, so direction is reversed.
Pitch accents anchor to stressed syllables, so stress theory helps.
Butler's account explicitly builds on Althusserian interpellation.
B already has conversational-implicature (formal-systems), which supplies the needed idea; the formal-semantics topic adds nothing.
Expert formal semantics is not needed for dramatic subtext; conversational-implicature already covers unspoken meaning.
Redundant with B's existing conversational-implicature prereq at the right stage.
Character motivation does not draw on the logical form of implicature.
Wrong level; if a pragmatics link is wanted, conversational-implicature (formal-systems) is the right source.
DRT is formal anaphora semantics; free indirect discourse is a narrative voice technique that does not use it.
Cross-cultural temporality theory is not drawn on by the authenticity-versus-invention tension.
The genre/literary boundary dispute is a dispute about literary value judgment.
Interpretive validity in literary analysis does not draw on formal presupposition theory.
Irony as implicature is a real link, but at conversational-implicature's level, not the formal logical-form topic.
Accentual verse counts stresses and B has no other stress source besides meter-and-rhythm.
Expert generative metrics is not needed; B already has metrical-systems-stress for the linguistic side.
Redundant with B's metrical-systems-stress and suprasegmental-phonology; formal stress models are not drawn on.
Redundant with metrical-systems-stress; poetic meter does not need expert metrical phonology.
Scansion needs heard stress, already covered by metrical-systems-stress and suprasegmental-phonology.
Cycle detection rests on DFS and leads toward DAGs, which topo sort requires; edge closes a near-cycle.
Master-theorem recurrences have nothing to do with topological ordering.
Asymptotic normality of the MLE uses the CLT; soft is right.
Single-oscillator forced response does not need multi-DOF normal modes.
The physical pendulum is a single-DOF system; normal modes build on it, not the reverse.
Biot-Savart computes fields from currents and does not use the force on a conductor.
B already has faradays-law as a hard prereq; the electrodynamics-course version is redundant.
Transformers are a core application and run on mutual inductance.
LC/RLC behavior cannot be analyzed without inductance; A looks over-staged at expert.
B's Core Idea derives BLv from the Lorentz force (already hard); Faraday's law is a helpful alternate view.
Motional EMF is derived directly from the Lorentz force on carriers; A looks over-staged.
Aufbau needs only the two-per-orbital rule; consider adding pauli-exclusion-principle as the hard prereq instead.
Standing waves need fixed-end conditions, not a formal Dirichlet/Neumann classification from electrodynamics.
